text:
The MGAP national forest map (Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries, 2021 version) is the source that gives the native-forest classification. Over the 2025 loss area, it maps about 13.1 ha as native forest, 0.0 ha as planted forest, and 0.4 ha outside mapped forest.

Two caveats:
- The other sources don't make this call. Hansen GFC only shows the 13.5 ha tree-cover loss in 2025. JRC GFC2020 only shows that the area was forest in 2020 (98% agreement), and it includes plantations.
- The MGAP map gives territorial context only, not the cause of the change. The result is also pending corroboration, because no later year has been observed. It doesn't establish deforestation, cause, legality, or who is responsible.
